name: Podcasts
description: Manage podcast subscriptions with automatic RSS feed updates, episode downloads, auto-delete after listening, and daily auto-playlist generation.
overview: Subscribe to podcast RSS feeds, automatically download new episodes, manage auto-deletion of listened content, and generate a daily auto-playlist of unlistened episodes.
changelog:
- Fixed: ROOT CAUSE of duplicate playlists — added SemaphoreSlim lock to prevent concurrent playlist generation (scheduler + manual trigger race condition)
- Fixed: Playlist GUID now persisted to plain text file (playlist_id.txt) instead of PluginConfiguration XML (which was cached and not persisted immediately)
- Fixed: Automatic migration from PluginConfiguration.PlaylistId to playlist_id.txt on first run
- Fixed: Automatic cleanup of legacy duplicate playlists (Podcasts1, Podcasts11, etc.)
- Pattern: Same architecture as jellyfin-smartlists-plugin — find by stored GUID, update in-place, never delete/recreate
